newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent firm in quiet Monday trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent firm in quiet Monday trade.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures were slightly firmer on Monday in quiet business, traders said.
"Nothing new at all - it's the same old stuff," one broker said.

August Brent was five cents a barrel up from Friday and stood at $18.11 a barrel at 1150 GMT, after trading in a narrow six-cent range for much of the day. July gas oil, which expires on Thursday, gained 75 cents a tonne to $162.75.
Traders were awaiting the open of U.S. markets which were closed on Friday for the Independence Day holiday.
Technical analysts were generally neutral to bearish.
"The majority of (energy) markets are leaning towards the negative side of neutral," MeesPierson Derivatives said in a daily report.
